mission_10: A complete quantum ML framework integrates all components — data encoding, quantum circuits, feature extraction, classical layers, training loops, and evaluation — into a unified system. The framework manages both quantum parameters (rotation angles in the variational circuit) and classical parameters (weights in pre/post-processing layers), optimizing them jointly through gradient-based training. Mini-batch training with numerical gradients enables practical optimization even when analytical gradients are unavailable. The framework tracks loss and accuracy history for monitoring convergence. In this mission, you implement a full quantum ML pipeline with classical-quantum-classical architecture, softmax-based classification, cross-entropy loss, mini-batch training with stochastic gradient estimation, accuracy tracking, and model summary reporting. This represents the culmination of quantum ML: a complete, trainable quantum-classical hybrid model.
